version: LOCK 47 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - Najmara, the star hill: the new masjid's qibla and the student who can't pay
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 40 stars. Design references (not shown): Quran 2:144 (turn your face toward the Sacred Masjid); Muslim 2699 (a path to knowledge).

najmara.name: Najmara
najmara.text: A village on a hill above the haze of the plain. At the top stands an observatory with a great brass quadrant, and its people sleep in the afternoon and work at night.

najmara.title: The new masjid
najmara.text: Fresh plaster, a mihrab still being carved, and a line scratched on the floor showing the qibla.
najmara.first: The builders show you the line on the floor proudly. “Checked by the stars.”

people.name: Hilal

lines.wary: Hilal is asleep in a chair with a slate on his chest.
lines.friendly: “The stars don't lie. People read them badly.”
lines.warm: “Come up tonight. I'll show you Suhayl rising.”

memory: “A hand's width. That's what the line moved. A hand's width toward Makkah.”

people.name: Kamil

lines.wary: Kamil is copying tables of numbers, lips moving.
lines.friendly: “One day I'll measure the whole earth. My teacher says it's been done. I want to check.”
lines.warm: “I passed the first examination. I thought of you.”

memory: “My teacher let me back in. I won't waste it.”

lines.wary: Sa'd is mixing plaster. “Mind your feet.”
lines.friendly: “Our grandfathers prayed in a field. Our grandsons will pray here.”
lines.warm: “When the dome is up, come and pray the first prayer under it.”

missions.title: The new masjid's qibla
missions.button: Hilal says the new masjid faces wrong

a.text: The village is building its first masjid. The builders marked the qibla by guesswork and the wall is already knee-high. Hilal says it points too far south.

choices.label: Help Hilal take the star sightings tonight

stars.text: At midnight Hilal sights the stars with the quadrant and works the sums on a slate. The line moves a hand's width north. The builders grumble, then knock down a morning's work and start again on the new line.

build.text: Sa'd's builders go on as they started. Hilal shakes his head and goes back to his tables.

fixed: Helped set the new masjid's qibla

missions.title: The student who can't pay
missions.kicker: Chapter 4 · The student who can't pay

a.text: Kamil the student has been sent away by his teacher: he can't pay the ten coins for the term. He sits on the observatory steps with his tables in his lap.

choices.label: Sit and study with him for an evening
Tell him to work and save

pay.text: His teacher takes the coins and Kamil back in the same afternoon.

study.text: You go through his tables together until the lamp burns low. He finds his own mistake.

none.text: Kamil nods. The next week he is carrying stones for Sa'd's builders.
